In BALB/c the relevant restriction is H2-IAd for the immunodominant OVA323-339 epitope, so the read out requires AID catalytic deamination for V-region SHM, CD40-CD40L licensing for GC entry/AID up-regulation/iterative selection, and cognate CD4+ Tfh help delivered via stable peptide-I-Ad presentation of OVA323-339. CpG ODN adjuvanticity in the prime-boost protocol is TLR9-MyD88 dependent and sets the magnitude of the T-dependent GC reaction that is measured. CD8/MHC I co-receptor function is dispensable for this CD4/MHC II restricted humoral read out.

G1 AID-(V18R). V18R is catalytically impaired / nuclear import defective AID. Deamination-dependent V-region SHM and the affinity maturation that depends on it are essentially abolished. No bona fide high-affinity SHM-derived OVA Ig is generated.

G2 CD40-KO. CD40 signalling on B cells is obligatory for GC formation, Tfh licensing, B cell survival and AID induction. Without CD40 the OVA response is extrafollicular and T-dependent SHM-driven affinity maturation is lost.

G3 H2-IAd-(E137A/V142A). E137/V142 are in the I-Ad β1 P1 peptide-binding pocket. E137A/V142A abrogates peptide loading/stable peptide-MHC II formation. OVA323-339 is not stably presented to I-Ad-restricted CD4+ T cells, OVA-specific priming/Tfh help is lost and the OVA-specific GC, SHM and high-affinity OVA Ig pool is lost.

G4 CD8-(V247D). CD8 V247D impairs MHC I-CD8 signalling and CTL function. Antibody affinity maturation and SHM to a protein antigen are CD4/MHC II T dependent. The OVA-specific SHM high-affinity titre is WT-like.

G5 H2-IAd-(T139A). In the BALB/c I-Ad molecule T139 lies in the β1/α2 helical face that forms the peptide-binding groove and makes direct contacts with the OVA323-339 anchor backbone, not only a clean CD4 docking surface. In the OVA+CpG repeated immunisation system T139A retains surface expression but selectively impairs binding/stability of the OVA323-339/I-Ad complex. That is functionally an OVA-specific MHC II presentation defect for the immunodominant epitope used here: OVA-specific CD4 priming, Tfh differentiation and the linked CD40L-mediated cognate help for OVA-specific B cells are effectively lost, germinal centre formation for OVA is lost and SHM-driven affinity maturation for OVA is lost. The phenotype is OVA-specific and phenocopies G3 for this antigen read out; it is not a benign separation-of-function in the OVA323-339 context.

G6 MyD88-KO. CpG ODN signals via TLR9-MyD88 in DCs and B cells. MyD88 deletion abrogates CpG-driven DC maturation, type I IFN/pro-inflammatory licensing and the TLR9-mediated amplification of CD4 priming and GC kinetics. With the stated repeated OVA+CpG prime-boost regimen the CpG adjuvant boost is lost and the absolute titre of high-affinity, SHM-carrying OVA-specific Ig obtained under the CpG-adjuvanted protocol is significantly reduced versus WT CpG-adjuvanted controls. The question asks for titre under the OVA+CpG protocol that is being used.

Hence the titre of high-affinity, SHM-derived OVA-specific antibodies is significantly altered relative to wild type in the AID catalytic mutant, CD40-deficient, the two I-Ad OVA presentation-defective mutants and the CpG-adjuvant MyD88-deficient mice, with the CD8 co-receptor mutant unchanged.

G1, G2, G3, G5, G6 – option C.

G2 CD40-KO
CD40 signalling on B cells is obligatory for GC formation, Tfh licensing, B cell survival and AID induction. CD40 deficiency abolishes a productive T-dependent GC and T-dependent SHM-driven affinity maturation to protein antigen. High-affinity SHM OVA Ig is lost.

G3 H2-IAd-(E137A/V142A)
E137/V142 are in the I-Aβ1 P1 peptide-binding pocket. E137A/V142A abrogates peptide loading / stable peptide–MHC II formation. OVA323-339 is not stably presented to I-Ad-restricted CD4+ T cells, OVA-specific CD4 priming/Tfh help is lost and the OVA-specific GC, SHM and high-affinity response are lost.

G4 CD8-(V247D)
CD8 V247D is an MHC I/CD8 co-receptor signalling lesion. Antibody affinity maturation/SHM to a soluble protein is CD4/MHC II T dependent. CD8 function is dispensable for the T-dependent humoral SHM read out. OVA-specific SHM high-affinity titre is WT-like.

G5 H2-IAd-(T139A)
In the BALB/c OVA system T139 lies in the I-Ad β1/α2 helical face that forms the peptide-binding groove and contacts the OVA323-339 anchor residues. CpG ODN signals via TLR9–MyD88 in DCs and B cells. MyD88 deletion abrogates CpG-driven DC maturation, type I IFN/pro-inflammatory licensing and the TLR9-mediated amplification of CD4 priming and GC kinetics. With the repeated subcutaneous OVA+CpG prime-boost regimen the CpG adjuvant boost is lost and the absolute titre of high-affinity, SHM-carrying OVA-specific Ig obtained under the CpG-adjuvanted protocol is significantly reduced versus WT CpG-adjuvanted controls.

Hence the titre of high-affinity, SHM-derived OVA-specific antibodies is significantly altered relative to wild type in the AID catalytic mutant, CD40-deficient, the two I-Ad OVA presentation defective mutants and the CpG-adjuvant MyD88-deficient mice, with the CD8 co-receptor mutant unchanged.

G1, G2, G3, G5, G6 altered; G4 WT-like. That is option C.

PRIVATE REFLECTION: The read-out is high-affinity, AID-dependent SHM-derived OVA-specific Ig after repeated s.c. OVA + CpG in BALB/c. Required for a T-dependent germinal centre product is AID catalytic deamination for V-region SHM, CD40–CD40L licensing for GC entry/AID up-regulation/iterative selection, and cognate CD4+ Tfh help via peptide–H2-IAd presentation of the immunodominant OVA323-339 epitope. CpG adjuvanticity is TLR9–MyD88 dependent and sets the magnitude of the measured response. CD8/MHC I is dispensable.

Consensus stable across rounds:
* G1 AID-(V18R): catalytically impaired/nuclear import defective AID → deamination-dependent SHM and affinity maturation abolished. Titre significantly different vs WT.
* G2 CD40-KO: no CD40 signalling → no GC formation, Tfh licensing, AID induction → no T-dependent SHM high-affinity OVA Ig. Significantly different.
* G3 H2-IAd-(E137A/V142A): P1 pocket peptide-binding groove mutant → abrogates stable peptide loading/presentation of OVA323-339 → no OVA-specific CD4 priming/Tfh help → OVA-specific GC/SHM lost. Significantly different.
* G4 CD8-(V247D): MHC I/CD8 co-receptor lesion. Antibody affinity maturation/SHM is CD4/MHC II dependent. Expected WT-like. No significant change.

Contested points now resolved toward majority view in round 3:
* G5 H2-IAd-(T139A): Majority now treat T139 as lying in the I-Ad β1/α2 peptide-binding groove contacting OVA323-339 anchor residues. T139A retains surface expression but selectively impairs binding/stability of the OVA peptide–I-Ad complex → functionally an OVA-specific MHC II presentation defect for OVA323-339 under repeated OVA+CpG. OVA-specific CD4 priming/Tfh help, GC formation and SHM-driven affinity maturation for OVA are lost, phenocopying G3 on an OVA-specific basis. Minority separation-of-function view that T139A is a CD4 co-receptor binding defect preserving peptide/TCR recognition is now outnumbered.
* G6 MyD88-KO: Majority interpretation for the stated protocol is that CpG ODN signals via TLR9–MyD88 for DC maturation/type I IFN and TLR9-mediated amplification of CD4 priming/GC kinetics. MyD88 deletion removes the CpG adjuvant boost, markedly reducing magnitude of the T-dependent GC reaction and absolute titre of high-affinity SHM-derived OVA-specific Ig obtained under the CpG-adjuvanted regimen vs WT CpG-adjuvanted controls. Even if the SHM programme per se is inducible, the titre under the specified OVA+CpG protocol is significantly reduced. Hence G6 is scored as different.

Current dominant public set is G1,G2,G3,G5,G6 = option C. Minority positions B = G1,G2,G3,G6 and D = G1,G2,G3,G5 reflecting earlier T139A separation-of-function and strict SHM-vs-titre interpretation of MyD88 are no longer the majority in round 3.

Unresolved nuance remains: exact molecular definition of T139A in BALB/c for OVA323-339, peptide groove vs CD4 docking, and whether MyD88 deficiency should be counted as qualitative loss of SHM or merely quantitative adjuvant-dependent reduction in titre. For the question as phrased – titre of high-affinity SHM OVA-specific antibodies under the OVA+CpG protocol – the majority treats both G5 and G6 as significant differences.

reflection_text.4:

Scored altered.
* Strict SHM-competence view: SHM programme per se can be initiated without MyD88; only adjuvant-boosted magnitude is lost. Minority.

Remaining uncertainty is the precise mechanistic reading of T139A as pure CD4-binding vs peptide-binding defect for OVA323-339, and whether MyD88-KO should be scored as qualitative loss of SHM vs quantitative adjuvant-dependent titre change. These drove earlier B/D splits, but the current majority supports C.

reflection_text.3:
The read-out is high-affinity, AID-dependent SHM-derived OVA-specific Ig after repeated s.c. OVA + CpG in BALB/c. Required for a T-dependent germinal centre product is AID catalytic deamination for V-region SHM, CD40–CD40L licensing for GC entry/AID up-regulation/iterative selection, and cognate CD4+ Tfh help via peptide–H2-IAd presentation of the immunodominant OVA323-339 epitope. CpG adjuvanticity is TLR9–MyD88 dependent and sets the magnitude of the measured response. CD8/MHC I is dispensable.

Consensus stable across rounds:
* G1 AID-(V18R): catalytically impaired/nuclear import defective AID → deamination-dependent SHM and affinity maturation abolished. Titre significantly different vs WT.
* G2 CD40-KO: no CD40 signalling → no GC formation, Tfh licensing, AID induction → no T-dependent SHM high-affinity OVA Ig. Significantly different.
* G3 H2-IAd-(E137A/V142A): P1 pocket peptide-binding groove mutant → abrogates stable peptide loading/presentation of OVA323-339 → no OVA-specific CD4 priming/Tfh help → OVA-specific GC/SHM lost. Significantly different.
* G4 CD8-(V247D): MHC I/CD8 co-receptor lesion. Antibody affinity maturation/SHM is CD4/MHC II dependent. Expected WT-like. No significant change.

Contested points now resolved toward majority view in round 3:
* G5 H2-IAd-(T139A): Majority now treat T139 as lying in the I-Ad β1/α2 peptide-binding groove contacting OVA323-339 anchor residues. T139A retains surface expression but selectively impairs binding/stability of the OVA peptide–I-Ad complex → functionally an OVA-specific MHC II presentation defect for OVA323-339 under repeated OVA+CpG. OVA-specific CD4 priming/Tfh help, GC formation and SHM-driven affinity maturation for OVA are lost, phenocopying G3 on an OVA-specific basis. Minority separation-of-function view that T139A is a CD4 co-receptor binding defect preserving peptide/TCR recognition is now outnumbered.
* G6 MyD88-KO: Majority interpretation for the stated protocol is that CpG ODN signals via TLR9–MyD88 for DC maturation/type I IFN and TLR9-mediated amplification of CD4 priming/GC kinetics. MyD88 deletion removes the CpG adjuvant boost, markedly reducing magnitude of the T-dependent GC reaction and absolute titre of high-affinity SHM-derived OVA-specific Ig obtained under the CpG-adjuvanted regimen vs WT CpG-adjuvanted controls. Even if the SHM programme per se is inducible, the titre under the specified OVA+CpG protocol is significantly reduced. Hence G6 is scored as different.

Current dominant public set is G1,G2,G3,G5,G6 = option C. Minority positions B = G1,G2,G3,G6 and D = G1,G2,G3,G5 reflecting earlier T139A separation-of-function and strict SHM-vs-titre interpretation of MyD88 are no longer the majority in round 3.

Unresolved nuance remains: exact molecular definition of T139A in BALB/c for OVA323-339, peptide groove vs CD4 docking, and whether MyD88 deficiency should be counted as qualitative loss of SHM or merely quantitative adjuvant-dependent reduction in titre. For the question as phrased – titre of high-affinity SHM OVA-specific antibodies under the OVA+CpG protocol – the majority treats both G5 and G6 as significant differences.

4.text:
High-affinity, SHM-carrying OVA-specific IgG after repeated s.c. OVA + CpG in BALB/c is a T-dependent germinal centre product that in BALB/c is essentially H2-IA^d restricted to the immunodominant OVA323-339 epitope.

The read-out therefore requires

* catalytic AID deamination in the GC B cell for V-region SHM and affinity maturation;
* CD40–CD40L licensing on the B cell for GC entry, Tfh licensing, B cell survival and AID up-regulation/iterative selection;
* cognate CD4+ Tfh help delivered by stable peptide–H2-IA^d presentation of OVA323-339.

CpG adjuvanticity in the prime-boost protocol is TLR9–MyD88 dependent and sets the magnitude of the adjuvanted T-dependent GC that is being measured. CD8/MHC I co-receptor function is dispensable for this CD4/MHC II restricted humoral read-out.

* G1 AID-(V18R). V18R is catalytically impaired / nuclear import defective AID. Deamination-dependent V-region SHM and the AID-dependent affinity maturation that depends on it are essentially abolished. No bona fide high-affinity SHM-derived OVA Ig is generated. Altered.

* G2 CD40-KO. CD40 signalling on B cells is obligatory for GC formation, Tfh licensing, B cell survival and AID induction. Without CD40 the OVA response is extrafollicular and T-dependent SHM-driven high-affinity Ig is lost. Altered.

* G3 H2-IAd-(E137A/V142A). E137/V142 are in the I-Aβ1 P1 peptide-binding pocket. E137A/V142A abrogates peptide loading / stable peptide–MHC II formation. OVA323-339 is not stably presented to IA^d-restricted CD4+ T cells, OVA-specific priming/Tfh help is lost and the OVA-specific GC/SHM/high-affinity pool is lost. Altered.

* G4 CD8-(V247D). MHC I/CD8 co-receptor signalling lesion. Antibody affinity maturation/SHM to a soluble protein is CD4/MHC II T dependent. CD8/MHC I function is dispensable for the T-dependent humoral SHM read-out. OVA-specific SHM high-affinity titre is WT-like. Unchanged.

* G5 H2-IAd-(T139A). In BALB/c IA^d T139 lies in the β1/α2 helical face of the peptide-binding groove and contacts the OVA323-339 anchor backbone. T139A retains surface expression but selectively impairs binding/surface stability of the OVA323-339/IA^d complex. In the repeated OVA+CpG system this is functionally an OVA-specific MHC II presentation defect: OVA-specific CD4 priming, Tfh differentiation and CD40L-mediated cognate help for OVA-specific B cells are lost, OVA-specific GC formation, AID expression and SHM-driven affinity maturation for OVA are lost, phenocopying G3 on an OVA-specific basis. Altered under the OVA read-out used here.

* G6 MyD88-KO. CpG ODN signals via TLR9–MyD88 in DCs and B cells. MyD88 deletion abrogates CpG-driven DC maturation, type I IFN/pro-inflammatory licensing and TLR9-mediated amplification of CD4 priming/GC kinetics. With the stated repeated OVA+CpG prime-boost regimen the CpG adjuvant boost is lost and the absolute titre of high-affinity, SHM-carrying OVA-specific Ig obtained under the CpG-adjuvanted protocol is significantly reduced versus WT CpG-adjuvanted controls.

Hence the titre of high-affinity, SHM-derived OVA-specific antibodies is significantly altered relative to wild type in G1, G2, G3, G5 and G6, with G4 unchanged.

That is G1, G2, G3, G5, G6 – option C.

PRIVATE REFLECTION: High-affinity SHM-derived OVA-specific IgG after repeated s.c. OVA+CpG in BALB/c is a T-dependent germinal centre read-out. * G4 CD8-V247D: MHC I/CD8 signalling lesion. Antibody affinity maturation/SHM is CD4/MHC II dependent. WT-like.

Persisting mechanistic points now resolved in current round:
G5 H2-IAd-T139A. Majority now adopts presentation-loss reading over CD4-co-receptor separation-of-function. T139 lies in I-Ad β1/α2 peptide-binding groove contacting OVA323-339 anchor backbone. T139A retains surface expression but selectively impairs binding/surface stability of OVA323-339/I-Ad. G6 MyD88-KO. Majority adopts adjuvant-magnitude reading for the protocol as asked. CpG ODN signals via TLR9-MyD88 in DCs/B cells for DC maturation/type I IFN/pro-inflammatory licensing and TLR9-mediated amplification of CD4 priming/GC kinetics. reflection_text.1:
High-affinity SHM-derived OVA-specific IgG after repeated s.c. OVA+CpG in BALB/c is a T-dependent germinal centre read-out. In BALB/c the immunodominant response is H2-IAd-restricted to OVA323-339, requiring catalytic AID deamination in GC B cells for V-region SHM/affinity maturation, CD40-CD40L licensing for GC entry/Tfh licensing/AID up-regulation, and cognate CD4+ Tfh help delivered via stable peptide-H2-IAd presentation of OVA323-339. CpG adjuvanticity in the prime-boost is TLR9-MyD88 dependent and sets the magnitude of the adjuvanted T-dependent GC that is measured. CD8/MHC I co-receptor function is dispensable for this CD4/MHC II humoral read-out.

Core consensus stable:
* G1 AID-V18R: catalytically impaired / nuclear import defective AID → V-region deamination, SHM and affinity maturation essentially abolished. Significantly different from WT.
* G2 CD40-KO: no CD40 signalling → no productive T-dependent GC, no AID induction, no SHM-driven high-affinity OVA Ig. Significantly different.
* G3 H2-IAd-E137A/V142A: I-Ad β1 P1 peptide-binding pocket mutant → abrogates stable peptide loading/presentation of OVA323-339 → loss of OVA-specific CD4 priming/Tfh help → loss of OVA-specific GC/SHM. Significantly different.
* G4 CD8-V247D: MHC I/CD8 signalling lesion. Antibody affinity maturation/SHM is CD4/MHC II dependent. WT-like.

G5 H2-IAd-T139A. Majority now adopts presentation-loss reading over CD4-co-receptor separation-of-function. T139 lies in I-Ad β1/α2 peptide-binding groove contacting OVA323-339 anchor backbone. Core requirements are catalytic AID deamination, CD40–CD40L licensing/GC and AID up-regulation, and cognate CD4+ Tfh help via stable peptide–I-Ad presentation of the immunodominant OVA323-339 epitope. CpG adjuvanticity is TLR9–MyD88 dependent and sets the magnitude of the adjuvanted GC that is being measured; CD8/MHC I is dispensable.

Uncontested:
* G1 AID-(V18R): catalytically impaired/nuclear import defective AID → deamination-dependent V-region SHM and affinity maturation lost → different from WT.
* G2 CD40-KO: no CD40L signalling → no T-dependent GC, no AID induction, no affinity maturation → different.
* G3 H2-IAd-(E137A/V142A): P1 pocket/peptide-binding groove mutant → stable OVA323-339/I-Ad formation abrogated → no OVA-specific CD4 priming/Tfh help → no OVA-specific GC/SHM → different.
* G4 CD8-(V247D): MHC I/CD8 co-receptor lesion. Antibody SHM/affinity maturation is CD4/MHC II dependent → titre WT-like.

Round 4 consensus:
G5 H2-IAd-(T139A) is now unanimously treated in this system as a peptide-binding groove/anchor contact mutation for OVA323-339, not a clean CD4 co-receptor separation-of-function. Surface expression retained but binding/surface stability of the immunodominant OVA peptide–I-Ad complex is selectively impaired → functionally OVA-specific MHC II presentation null → loss of OVA-specific CD4 priming/Tfh help and OVA-specific GC/SHM/high-affinity titre. Phenocopies G3 on an OVA-specific basis under the OVA+CpG regimen → different.

G6 MyD88-KO: CpG signals via TLR9–MyD88 for DC maturation, type I IFN/pro-inflammatory licensing and TLR9-mediated amplification of CD4 priming/GC kinetics. MyD88 deletion abrogates the CpG adjuvant boost, so the absolute titre of high-affinity SHM-carrying OVA-specific Ig obtained with the stated OVA+CpG prime-boost is significantly reduced vs WT CpG-adjuvanted controls → different for the titre measured under the protocol.

Current deliberation weighting round 4: 18/18 explicit public endorsements in this round are option C, G1,G2,G3,G5,G6, G4 unchanged. This matches the dominant consensus from round 3.

Retained minority/alternative readings for tracking:
* T139A as CD4 docking separation-of-function with peptide binding/TCR recognition largely intact → G5 WT-like → option D.
* MyD88 loss as only quantitative adjuvant loss, SHM programme per se intact → G6 WT-like for strict SHM programme read-out → option B/D.

Unresolved nuance kept: exact structural classification of I-Ad T139A for OVA323-339 – peptide anchor pocket vs CD4 contact – and whether “significantly different titre” is scored as loss of SHM programme per se vs quantitative loss of CpG-adjuvant-boosted GC magnitude in MyD88-KO under the stated OVA+CpG regimen. Current consensus adopts peptide-presentation and adjuvant-magnitude interpretations → option C.

I retain unanimous G1,G2,G3 different, G4 WT-like, and dominant current consensus that both G5 and G6 are scored as significantly different under the stated protocol, i.e. G1,G2,G3,G5,G6, option C.
